tools.name: search_dia
tools.description: Semantic search across Digital in Asia articles, trackers, reports and glossary on Asia's digital economy (AI, gaming, ecommerce, payments, super apps, policy). Understands natural-language questions. Returns titles, URLs, dates and the most relevant passages.

tools.name: get_country_profile
tools.description: Overview of one Asian digital market from Digital in Asia: the country hub summary, that country's rows from every DIA tracker (payments, ecommerce, gaming, AI policy, AI model access), and the most relevant recent articles. Markets: China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore,

tools.name: compare_markets
tools.description: Put two or more Asian markets side by side using Digital in Asia's tracker data. Optionally limit to a topic (payments, ecommerce, gaming, AI policy, AI models). Returns comparison tables with source links.

tools.name: get_tracker
tools.description: Get structured data tables from a Digital in Asia market tracker (payment rails, LLM availability and benchmarks, gaming, ecommerce marketplaces, AI policy, AI market size). Call with no arguments to list trackers.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List Digital in Asia's free research reports with titles, descriptions, dates and links.

tools.name: get_report_summary
tools.description: Key findings and section headings of a Digital in Asia research report (fintech and digital payments, AI in Asia, Southeast Asia ecommerce, Vietnam gaming), plus the link to the free PDF.

tools.name: get_glossary_term
tools.description: Look up a term in the Digital in Asia glossary (103 terms, e.g. UPI, QRIS, super app, live commerce, sovereign AI). Returns the definition and link; suggests close matches.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: The most recent Digital in Asia articles, optionally filtered by a phrase.
